purpose: Resolve South Sea pearl color-reference gap with an official CC0 Smithsonian source.

sources.source_site: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
sources.title: South Sea Glow Necklace (Catalog Number: G11441)
sources.license_evidence: Smithsonian page explicitly states: media is in the public domain and may be copied, modified and distributed without contacting the Smithsonian.
sources.use: gold-to-white South Sea/Akoya color transition evidence; especially useful for the natural golden South Sea color family
sources.notes: The source is a finished jewelry piece, not an isolated pearl. Use as color/luster evidence, then create a standardized isolated display asset; do not copy the jewelry design.

decision.remaining_work: Create white and golden South Sea standardized representative/grade assets using pearl luster, surface, roundness and body-color axes.
